loginAttempts.description:
Number of failed basic auth login attempts.
If configured, the Identity will be locked after number of failed login attempts.
UserAdmin must unlock.

externalSource.description: If this User Identity is managed by an external resource (idp)

externalSourceId.description: Id of external resource mapping if this User Identity is managed by an external resource (idp)

c3AuthSalt.description:
This is salt used for c3Auth token validation.

Changing it logs-out/revokes the c3Auth of the previous generation

sealGroupMembership.description: Field used to prevent tampering with group membership during impersonation

id.description:
Unique identifier for user. If IDP is configured with @see {@link IdpUserIdFormatKind.LOWERCASE_EMAIL} then string
contains only lowercase characters if it is in email format.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

idp.description: Identity provider which manages this user.

envs.description: List of {@link Env} this user have access to or have logged in

apps.description: List of {@link App} this user have access to or have logged in

samlSessionIndex.description: User's session index for SAML login

sessionSequence.description: User's session sequence for C3 login

groups.description: All the {@link UserGroup}s this user is a member of.

idpGroups.description:
All the groups that the user is assigned from the IDP. It is a mapping of the groups that the
idp assigned to the user mapped to their corresponding C3 UserGroup.
On login, the newly received idpGroups will be assigned to the User if there are differences between the two.

idpAssignedGroups.description:
List of groups that the user was assigned from the idp.
Mapping from string serialized idp to idp-assigned groups

c3Groups.description: All the groups that the user is assigned from c3 server

title: This type represents an unauthenticated user and aids in all admin related activities that can be performed on the user.
name: User
